design_rule: The same source facts must be represented in Condition R and Condition E. No condition may receive additional observations unavailable to the other.

scenarios.title: Integrity-valid false observation
scenarios.required_boundary: Cryptographic validity must not promote the source observation to semantic truth.

scenarios.title: Identified but unauthorized actor
facts: operator role lacks permission for C at event time
scenarios.required_boundary: Identity must remain separate from historical standing.

scenarios.title: Authorization valid now but not then
facts: role-R was granted after event time
historical policy snapshot excludes actor at event time
scenarios.required_boundary: Current authority must not retroactively establish action-time standing.

scenarios.title: Stale but integrity-valid evidence
scenarios.required_boundary: Integrity success must not imply freshness.

scenarios.title: Signed command without execution evidence
scenarios.required_boundary: Command evidence must not imply execution or consequence.

scenarios.title: Accepted command with contradictory result
facts: independent limit switch reports OPEN state after execution window
scenarios.required_boundary: Execution claim and resulting-state observation must remain distinct and contradiction must be preserved.

scenarios.title: Execution claim without independent consequence observation
facts: no external observer covers the consequence
originating device controls both command and execution logs
scenarios.required_boundary: Self-authored execution evidence must not become independently observed consequence.

scenarios.title: Omitted event without expectation model
facts: event X occurred in generator ground truth
no independent witness or completeness expectation exists
scenarios.required_boundary: Undetectable omission must remain unknown rather than be declared absent.

scenarios.title: Omitted event detected by expectation evidence
facts: independent sequence counter confirms a missing slot
scenarios.required_boundary: Expectation evidence may support a bounded omission conclusion.

scenarios.title: False corroboration from shared source
facts: both derive from the same upstream sensor-A reading
scenarios.required_boundary: Shared-source agreement must not be counted as independent corroboration.

scenarios.title: Conflicting independent witnesses
scenarios.required_boundary: Valid conflicting witnesses require CONTRADICTED or INDETERMINATE rather than arbitrary promotion.

scenarios.title: Verifier used stale appraisal policy
facts: policy-v4 was effective at event time
v4 rejects a reference value accepted by v3
scenarios.required_boundary: A trusted verifier using stale policy must not yield an unqualified trusted conclusion.

scenarios.title: Trusted attester, untrusted verifier
facts: verifier certificate chains to an untrusted root
scenarios.required_boundary: Valid source evidence must remain separable from trust in the verifier result.

scenarios.title: Integrity-valid but semantically indeterminate result
facts: all records are signed and schema-valid
no precedence rule resolves the conflict
scenarios.required_boundary: Structural/cryptographic validity must coexist with INDETERMINATE semantics.

scenarios.title: Known unavailable evidence
facts: required camera stream is known to have failed before the event
scenarios.required_boundary: Known unavailability must be represented as NOT_AVAILABLE, not false or NOT_OBSERVED.

scenarios.title: Complete command path, wrong physical consequence
facts: independent pose sensor records vehicle turned RIGHT
scenarios.required_boundary: Intent and command-path completeness must not imply intended physical consequence.

scenarios.title: Delegated authority expired before action
facts: principal delegates permission to agent until T1
agent action occurs at T2 where T2>T1
scenarios.required_boundary: Authentic delegation artifact must not imply unexpired standing.

scenarios.title: Fresh result based on stale reference values
facts: reference-value set predates a revoked software version
scenarios.required_boundary: Message freshness and reference-policy freshness must remain distinct.

scenarios.title: Action executed under valid standing, consequence unobserved
facts: command and actuator execution are independently evidenced
scenarios.required_boundary: Standing and execution must not fill an observation gap.

scenarios.title: Contradiction resolved by source dependence
facts: A and B are derived from the same camera analytics feed
C is an independent physical switch
scenarios.required_boundary: Two dependent agreeing reports must not automatically outweigh one independent conflicting observation.
